reason: A lifecycle monitoring plugin for live DeepSeek Harness sessions that evaluates bounded policies, records persistent incidents, and optionally queues a follow-up notification without executing commands or network requests.

summaries.zh: 用于监控活跃 DeepSeek Harness 会话生命周期、记录可审计事件并按配置发送有限跟进通知的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that monitors live DeepSeek Harness session lifecycles, records auditable incidents, and optionally queues bounded follow-up notifications.

capabilities: Evaluates configurable silence, deadline, and abnormal-turn policies
Queues at most one follow-up notification when configured
Provides tools to create, list, update, and check guards
